run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T05:21:00Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert matches a burst of ERROR-status frontend spans from 05:21:00Z to roughly 05:32-05:36Z (5-minute increase peaked ~1,016 at 05:25; frontend ERROR/total ratio was 0 at 05:36). The errors are confined to the /api/data route and its downstream ad call: span_name GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect. frontend-proxy shows its own ERROR spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' in the same interval. The ad service recorded no ERROR spans at all, but its GetAds server spans vanished from about 05:21 to about 05:29/05:30 immediately after Deployment ad was restarted: its pod template carries kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T05:19:49Z, a new ReplicaSet ad-d89765fb5 replaced ad-554b849958, the new pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz started at 05:19:49 but its ad container logged 'Ad service starting.' only at 05:24:02, and the ad container defines no readiness/liveness/startup probe, so the Service could point at a pod whose application was not listening yet. Checked and not tied to this cause: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running, no Node-kind events appeared in the all-namespace event grouping, all other otel-demo Deployments lack a restartedAt annotation, and Service ad endpoints now resolve only to ad-d89765fb5-whfnz. Unknowns: the alerting rule definition could not be read, Jaeger returned no traces for the error window (~05:17 onwards) and frontend container logs were empty, kube-state-metrics availability series returned nothing, and who/what issued the rollout restart is not available (change_history not integrated).

claims.text: Frontend spans with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR rose from 0 before 05:21:00Z to a peak 5-minute increase of ~1,015.6 at 05:25:00Z, stayed elevated through 05:31-05:32Z and were 0 by 05:32-05:36Z; a frontend ERROR/total span ratio evaluated at 05:36:00Z returned 0.

Among the frontend span_name series returned with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR, non-zero increases occur only on GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect (e.g. at 05:25:00Z they were 252.2, 252.2, 252.2 and 12.2 per 5 minutes), while returned series GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder were 0.

frontend-proxy's own ERROR spans appear on span_name 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' over the same interval, peaking at about 505.6 and 252.2 spans per 5-minute increase around 05:25-05:26Z and returning to 0 by ~05:37Z.

The ad service recorded no ERROR-status spans in the window: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getRandomAds and getAdsByCategory spans all carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and only the flagd.evaluation resolver series carry a STATUS_CODE_ERROR label with value 0. Its GetAds 5-minute increase fell from ~226.7 at 05:20:00Z to 0 for evaluations covering ~05:21-05:29Z and returned to non-zero from ~05:29:30-05:30:00Z; a 1-minute view shows no GetAds spans from 05:21:00Z through 05:29:15Z.

Frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds first records ERROR increases at 05:20:30Z (64 per 1 minute) and continues with 116-118 per minute through 05:27:15Z, i.e. immediately after the ad pod replacement.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo carries the pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T05:19:49Z; it is the only otel-demo Deployment with that restartedAt (flagd's is 04:48:58Z and all others have none).

ReplicaSet ad-d89765fb5 was created at 05:19:49Z with 1 ready replica and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (created 04:47:22Z) was scaled to 0 replicas; both are controller-owned by Deployment ad (uid e5286549-6261-4f09-8c3c-b73dae8f2cdc), and both the surviving pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz and the deleted pod used image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad.

otel-demo events at 05:19:49-05:19:52Z show Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet up ad-d89765fb5 from 0 to 1, pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started, Deployment ad scaling down ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0, and pod ad-554b849958-gcmfq 'Stopping container ad' with ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete.

ad-d89765fb5-whfnz is Running and Ready with 0 restarts and startTime 05:19:49Z, but the only line its ad container wrote between 05:15:00Z and 05:40:00Z is 'Ad service starting.' at 2026-11-17T05:24:02.903167388Z, and the pod has no previous container instance.
Deployment ad's container spec defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe for port 8080, and sets resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi with requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi.
Service ad's endpoints currently contain only pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz at 100.96.1.122:8080 on node i-00afa9d1463304f93.

All 21 pods in namespace otel-demo are in phase Running; the only pod with a non-zero restart count is fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-vzsmb (1). The ad pod shares node i-00afa9d1463304f93 with accounting-58d4b6c958-fth2t, currency-5d455cf6f7-nkfgv, kafka-ff7884766-j2br4, product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-k82fl and shipping-75d58f5d84-c54qm.

Grouping all events across namespaces returned only kinds Deployment, Job, PersistentVolume, PersistentVolumeClaim, Pod, ReplicaSet and StatefulSet - no Node-kind events - with timestamps between 05:01:36Z and 05:29:51Z.

The flagd-config ConfigMap currently holds demo.flagd.json with adFailure defaultVariant 'off', adHighCpu 'off', cartFailure 'off', paymentFailure 'off', paymentUnreachable 'off', productCatalogFailure 'off', recommendationCacheFailure 'off', kafkaQueueProblems 'off', imageSlowLoad 'off', loadGeneratorFloodHomepage 'off' and emailMemoryLeak 'off'; only adManualGc has defaultVariant 'on'.

When ad served requests its GetAds duration histogram shows no latency inflation: at 05:20:00Z 197.8 of 226.7 per-5-minute spans were in the <=10ms bucket and essentially none above 1000ms, and at 05:33-05:36Z the <=10ms bucket again held most spans (e.g. 159.3 of 273.8 at 05:33Z).

Deployment ad applied the pod-template change at 05:19:49Z that replaced its only ad pod (new ReplicaSet ad-d89765fb5, old ad-554b849958 to 0); frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds ERROR spans begin at 05:20:30-05:21:00Z, ad served no GetAds spans from ~05:21 to ~05:29/05:30Z while its new container only logged application start at 05:24:02Z, and Deployment ad has no readiness probe - this ad rollout is the origin of the frontend RequestErrorRate burst.

Mechanism: because the ad container has no readiness probe, the ad Service endpoint was switched to ad-d89765fb5-whfnz as soon as the container started at 05:19:51Z, before the ad application was listening (it logged 'Ad service starting.' at 05:24:02Z); frontend's AdService/GetAds calls therefore failed and its tcp.connect spans recorded connection errors until ad served traffic again at ~05:29-05:30Z. Why the ad process took about four minutes after container start is not explained by the evidence collected.

A flagd-injected ad fault (adFailure/adHighCpu) is a remaining but disfavoured candidate: the flagd-config read now shows both 'off', and ad recorded no ERROR-status spans and served no GetAds requests during the gap; the ConfigMap's value at 05:21Z itself is not readable, so this cannot be fully excluded from the config alone.

ad latency degradation (e.g. high CPU or the adManualGc 'on' default triggering GC pauses) causing frontend timeouts is not supported: ad's served GetAds calls stay in the <=10ms duration bucket with essentially none above 1000ms, and during the error window ad produced no GetAds spans at all rather than slow ones.

A node-level fault on i-00afa9d1463304f93 is not supported: all otel-demo pods including the five others co-located on that node are Running, only the ad pod was replaced (its own controller's ReplicaSet events), and the all-namespace event grouping contains no Node-kind events.

The error burst does not extend to the other frontend routes in the returned series: GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder all show 0 ERROR increases, so within the observed series only the ad call path failed.

Add a readinessProbe (gRPC/TCP on port 8080) to the ad container and change Deployment ad's rolling-update strategy to maxUnavailable: 0 with maxSurge: 1 (or run more than one ad replica) so a pod restart cannot remove the only serving ad endpoint while the new process is still starting.

Investigate why the ad process logged its start about four minutes after the container started (image/startup path, cpu limit of 50m, node conditions) and confirm through audit/change history who issued the kubectl rollout restart recorded as restartedAt 2026-11-17T05:19:49Z.

gaps: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate and also none without a filter, so the alert's expression, 'for' duration and evaluation interval could not be verified.

Jaeger returned no traces for the error window: traces_search for frontend 05:21:00-05:23:00Z and 05:20:00-05:35:00Z (limit 5-6) returned nothing, traces_search_by_tags error=true matched nothing, and the only large trace result held spans between 05:17:31Z and 05:17:34Z; the error text/status tags of the failing GetAds calls are therefore unknown.
Frontend container logs returned 0 lines read for 05:18:00-05:35:00Z both filtered and unfiltered, so no frontend application error message is available.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="otel-demo",deployment="ad"}, kube_pod_container_info{namespace="otel-demo",pod=~"ad-.*"} and any kube_pod_*/kube_replicaset_* metric names returned no data, so ad's available-replica count and pod image digests during the gap could not be verified from Prometheus.
The previous ad container/pod (ad-554b849958-gcmfq) was deleted, so its logs, termination reason and exit code could not be read; the new pod has no previous container instance.
change_history is not integrated in this Run, so who or what issued the ad rollout restart at 2026-11-17T05:19:49Z is unknown.

rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="frontend"} returned no series and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count has no series, so gRPC/HTTP status codes for the failing calls could not be corroborated.

The precise start and end of the ad-serving gap and of the frontend error burst differ slightly between the 1-minute and 5-minute increase views (ad gap ~05:21-05:29Z in the 1-minute view; frontend errors non-zero in 5-minute windows until ~05:31-05:36Z but zero in 1-minute windows after 05:27:15Z; ratio 0 at 05:36Z).
Events cover only their own timestamps inside the authorized window (observed range 05:01:36-05:29:51Z); earlier events have expired and cannot be inspected.

cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, kafka, product-catalog, quote and shipping returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all; that is unknown, not evidence that they were error-free, and their application health was not verified.

The fraud-detection pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-vzsmb reports restart count 1 and fraud-detection had low-level (~1.1 per 5 minutes) background ERROR increases at 05:16-05:18Z and 05:23-05:26Z; the restart time is unknown and no evidence ties it to the ad path.
The flagd-config value read is the ConfigMap's state at query time, not at 05:21Z, so the fault-injection flag values during the incident cannot be confirmed.
next_steps: Add and tune a readinessProbe for the ad container and set Deployment ad's strategy to maxUnavailable: 0 / maxSurge: 1 (or scale ad beyond one replica) so pod replacement does not remove the only serving endpoint.

Review ad startup behaviour (container start 05:19:51Z vs 'Ad service starting.' at 05:24:02Z), including image extraction time, node conditions on i-00afa9d1463304f93 and whether the 50m CPU limit throttles startup.
Use audit logs or the missing change_history integration to identify the actor/command behind the kubectl rollout restart annotated at 2026-11-17T05:19:49Z.
Once log/trace retention allows, confirm the exact frontend error text for grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (connection refused vs deadline exceeded) to validate the unavailability mechanism.
